figures.caption: Export Share against YoY Share Change, shown to answer whether product groups with larger overall export shares experience higher year-on-year share volatility. The National Directorate of Statistics compiled customs trade declaration summaries from January 2021 through December 2023 to monitor structural shifts in merchandise export composition and evaluate national trade exposure across major trading partner economies.
